In an experiment to demonstrate the wave nature of matter, electrons are accelerated from rest through a potential difference and directed at a thin polycrystalline metal foil. A diffraction pattern consisting of concentric rings is observed on a fluorescent screen behind the foil. Which row correctly describes the change in the de Broglie wavelength of the electrons and the diameter of the rings when is increased?

De Broglie wavelengthDiameter of rings
A.increasesincreases
B.increasesdecreases
C.decreasesdecreases
D.decreasesincreases
